subject: Word stress for every lemma of the top-12,000 Ukrainian frequency list: one confident stress where the sources agree, labeled variants and homographs where they do not, provenance per row; proper nouns kept but out of scope
method: Nine stages, applied in order: the lang-uk ukrainian-word-stress dictionary read directly from its trie and filtered by the list's own UD part of speech and lemma features (no tagger guess on a bare lemma); en.wiktionary (kaikki.org), which separates free variants, homographs and minor variants; uk.wiktionary (the dump); a two-of-three vote where the three disagree; rules for conflicts that are only apparent (compound secondary stress, doubled-accent artifacts); goroh.pp.ua tiebreaks for what is left, one reference lookup per word, recorded as the attested stress only; rules for lemmas no source covers (standard spelling, compounds, acronyms, -енко surnames); uk.wikipedia lead sentences for names; and the manual-decision ledger applied last.
scope: Proper nouns (PROPN) are out of scope by owner decision 2026-10-01: kept with the pipeline's stress and status in the note, counted in no share.
